h: The Gatherer and the Mistake of Seeking Holiness Through Sin

p: בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ, חֵלֶק ג קנז, א)
In the holy Zohar (on this parshah, Zohar III 157a):
and he was examining these trees,
הֵי מִינַּיְיהוּ רַב עַל אָחֳרָא וְכוּלֵּי
which of them was greater than the other…" and so on;
in the sin of the Vav…" and so on.
there is the Tree of Life,
and there is the Tree of Knowledge of good and evil;
and through teshuvah one can make
out of the Tree of Knowledge of good and evil
so that deliberate sins become like merits,
and it too becomes the Tree of Life.
שֶׁאֶפְשָׁר שֶׁרְצוֹן הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ הוּא כֵּן
that perhaps the will of Hashem Yisbarach is so:
that they should first go astray
and that from this would come "very good,"
and it would be of an even higher level,
"In the place where baalei teshuvah stand,
And he thought that this was right
to bring out the light from within the darkness,
And this is what the Midrash says
that he intended it for the sake of Heaven,
and certainly he gave himself over to death,
for such is the law of the warning.
he would come to the life of the World to Come,
and have a share in the World to Come,
and from this would come "very good."
for it is only after the fact:
then it will become clear in the future:
"If your sins be like the years
from the six days of Creation
they shall be made white as snow"
That is, it will become clear
that immediately in the utterance of Bereishis
for such was the creation of the world:
and this is that there is no light
except that which emerges from within darkness,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב קפד, א)
as is written in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 184a);
and then they will be made
certainly, Heaven forbid to think so,
and it is forbidden to rely on this;
and "one who says, I will sin and repent,
for he intended it for the sake of Heaven,
as written in the Midrash mentioned above;
only he erred in his thinking.
וְזֶה שֶׁאָמַר בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ הַנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל
And this is what the holy Zohar cited above says:
from the side of the Tree of Life,
and it also has in it
the revelation of Atika as well;
that is, that it will become clear:
"If your sins be…" and so on,
"they shall be made white as snow."
he died in the sin of the Vav,
which is the Tree of Life.
is the aspect of the Written Torah,
which is called the Tree of Life;
and the Tree of Knowledge of good and evil
is the aspect of Torah she'b'al peh,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (בְּרֵאשִׁית, חֵלֶק א כז, א)
as is written in the holy Zohar (Bereishis, Zohar I 27a);
And this is the matter of what is stated
בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (שָׁם, חֵלֶק ג קנז, א)
in the holy Zohar (there, Zohar III 157a):
that is, the aspect of the Written Torah,
who is the root of the Written Torah.
And this is what the holy Zohar says:
the most hidden of all hidden,
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב סד, ב)
And this is what the holy Zohar says
that the fruit of the land is greater…" and so on,
it flows and is drawn…" and so on;
that is, the root of Torah she'b'al peh,
which is from the dew of Atika,
"My word shall distill like the dew";
וְהַיְינוּ לְתַקֵּן הָעֵץ הַדַּעַת טוֹב וָרָע
that is, to repair the Tree of Knowledge of good and evil,
so that it will be "very good":
And this is what the holy Zohar says:
the aspect of the Written Torah,
the Torah was given on Shabbos;
and also the aspect of Torah she'b'al peh,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק א מז, ב)
as is written in the holy Zohar (Zohar I 47b):
is Torah she'b'al peh…" and so on;
we call it Torah she'b'al peh."
וְזֶהוּ פֵּירוּשׁ הַזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ הַנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל
And this is the meaning of the holy Zohar cited above:
and the Tree of Knowledge of good and evil,
so that it will be "very good,"
for both are the holiness of Shabbos.
But Shabbos, its attribute is peace
(וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ רֵישׁ פָּרָשַׁת קֹרַח)
(as is written in the holy Zohar, beginning of Parshas Korach),
and it will be further explained below
